Weekend support queue looks clear on my end unless new issues surface.

I'll be on-site Saturday morning to meet the HVAC crew and manage building access, so that won't require additional coverage. For Monday's new hires, I'll stage the desks in their assigned areas Sunday evening to keep Monday morning clear for any last-minute issues.

The loading dock repair estimate came in under budget at $3,200. I'm approving it and scheduling the work for next Tuesday to avoid the Thursday delivery rush. I'll coordinate with security on access codes and post signage by Monday end of day.
